question: What is the value of ((7)/(8) × 2.4) ÷ 0.6?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Apply the BODMAS rule by solving the bracket first: (7/8 × 2.4) Simplify the multiplication: 2.4 ÷ 8 = 0.3, so 7 × 0.3 = 2.1 Now perform the division: 2.1 ÷ 0.6 Since both numbers have one decimal place, remove the decimals directly: 21 ÷ 6 Simplify the fraction: 21/6 = 7/2 = 3.5 **∴ The correct answer is 3.5.**
